entities.name: Tazri

events.summary: Linvala survives the Eldrazi release and joins the fight against Kozilek.
events.quote: Linvala survived the initial release of the Eldrazi and joined the fight against the titan Kozilek

events.summary: Linvala flies to Sea Gate, tired of other angels' inaction, and backs Tazri's reconstruction proposal.
events.quote: flew to Sea Gate to offer her services

events.summary: The party, including Linvala, fights compleated Nahiri at Emeria and breaks her from the Hedron network.
events.quote: the party managed to break Nahiri loose from the reformed Hedron network and knock her from her feet

events.summary: Linvala and Drana fight in the same skies and come to respect each other.
events.quote: bloodchief magic and angelic powers complemented each other surprisingly well

relations.quote: has transformed into one of respect and appreciation for the other's power and skills
She immediately stood behind Tazri's proposal for the reconstruction of the city
